purpose: Host MIME database manifest for the round-97 C1 filetype counter: the eight text files of /usr/share/mime plus mime.cache with bytes+sha256, so the counter can copy a declared text-mode database and know when a cache-mode database must NOT be used.

source.access: read-only: sha256sum + stat only; the source tree was never written

cache_validity: mime.cache is 207520 bytes; GLib's cache reader requires >= 40 bytes and version 1.1 or 1.2 at offsets 0..3 (xdgmimecache.c:107-163). The host's /usr/share/mime carries a loadable cache, so XDG_DATA_DIRS=/usr/share/mime puts the oracle in cache mode; a text-mode case must copy ONLY the eight text files into a fresh mime/ dir.
copy_recipe_text_mode: for f in magic globs globs2 aliases subclasses icons generic-icons XMLnamespaces; do cp "/usr/share/mime/$f" "$S/hostdb/mime/$f"; done
cross_check: globs2 sha256 556ee69c8be2e24c4e3025dc5af0bdae71c6dca899491b4c95778a531958168e equals the round-94/95/96 pins; the DB has not drifted since round 94.
